manifest.scope: Client inventory, balance, gifts and visual previews are simulations.

Fruits.name: Blade
Fruits.description: Grants the user a body of blades, offering immunity to sword attacks and sharp striking abilities.

Fruits.name: Blizzard
Fruits.description: Grants the user control over violent blizzards, allowing them to cloak themselves in freezing winds and dominate enemies with crushing cold.

Fruits.name: Bomb
Fruits.description: Provides the user with a wide range of explosive attacks.

Fruits.name: Buddha
Fruits.description: Transforms the user into a giant Buddha, increasing the user's size, power, and defense, making it perfect for farming.

Fruits.name: Control
Fruits.description: Allows the user to control objects and enemies within a specified area.

Fruits.name: Creation
Fruits.description: Creates barriers for defense and can trap enemies.

Fruits.name: Dark
Fruits.description: Provides darkness-based abilities which pull enemies in closer to you.

Fruits.name: Diamond
Fruits.description: Turns the user into diamond, enhancing defense and providing sharp attacks.

Fruits.name: Dough
Fruits.description: Provides sticky and flexible dough-based attacks.

Fruits.name: Dragon
Fruits.description: Transforms the user into a mighty dragon, allowing them to rule over the skies with scorching flames.

Fruits.name: Dragon (East)
Fruits.description: Transforms the user into a mighty dragon, allowing them to rule over the skies with scorching flames.

Fruits.name: Dragon (West)
Fruits.description: Transforms the user into a mighty dragon, allowing them to rule over the skies with scorching flames.

Fruits.name: Eagle
Fruits.description: Gives the user wings and bird-like attacks.

Fruits.name: Flame
Fruits.description: Enables the user to control and create fire, forcing enemies to steer clear if they don't want to burn.

Fruits.name: Gas
Fruits.description: Allows the user to exhale clouds of explosive gas and transform into a powerful gaseous knight.

Fruits.name: Ghost
Fruits.description: Allows the user to transcend the barrier between life and death, granting an extra life and paranormal abilities.

Fruits.name: Gravity
Fruits.description: Allows the user to manipulate gravity, controlling the battlefield.

Fruits.name: Ice
Fruits.description: Allows the user to manipulate ice, freezing their foes in place.

Fruits.name: Kitsune
Fruits.description: Grants fox-like abilities, with amazing agility and blue fire-based attacks. Damage enemies to fully transform into the mythical Kitsune.

Fruits.name: Light
Fruits.description: Grants light-speed movement and powerful light-based attacks.

Fruits.name: Lightning
Fruits.description: Provides electric-based attacks, which have stun based effects.

Fruits.name: Love
Fruits.description: Use charming abilities to debuff enemies, and to summon your Besto Friendo.

Fruits.name: Magma
Fruits.description: Grants magma-based attacks that deal high damage and burn enemies.

Fruits.name: Mammoth
Fruits.description: Transforms the user into a mammoth, providing strength and size.

Fruits.name: Pain
Fruits.description: Inflicts pain-based attacks, causing damage over time.

Fruits.name: Phoenix
Fruits.description: Grants regenerative abilities, powerful fire-based attacks, and the ability to transform into a full body Phoenix.

Fruits.name: Portal
Fruits.description: Allows the user to instantly travel to any location or create a portal to a dimension of their own.

Fruits.name: Quake
Fruits.description: Provides the ability to create shockwaves, dealing massive area damage.

Fruits.name: Rocket
Fruits.description: Grants explosive movement abilities, allowing quick travel and attacks.

Fruits.name: Rubber
Fruits.description: Grants the user a rubber body, immune to electric attacks and stretchy enough to deal a barrage of offensive attacks.

Fruits.name: Sand
Fruits.description: Grants control over sand, with abilities to trap and attack.

Fruits.name: Shadow
Fruits.description: Grants life-leeching abilities, useful for tactical takedowns of your enemies.

Fruits.name: Smoke
Fruits.description: Offers the user an arsenal of smoke attacks, and is useful for grinding as a new player.

Fruits.name: Sound
Fruits.description: Use instrument based attacks or ride along sheets of music to power-up this Fruit.

Fruits.name: Spider
Fruits.description: Grants spider-like abilities, including web attacks and agility.

Fruits.name: Spike
Fruits.description: Grants the user sharp spikes on their body, full of offensive attacks skills.

Fruits.name: Spin
Fruits.description: Provides spinning attacks which will injure enemies with razor sharp wind slashes.

Fruits.name: Spirit
Fruits.description: Grants the user the ability to manipulate spirits, which can offer the user heavenly buffs to themselves or disastrous traps to their enemies.

Fruits.name: Spring
Fruits.description: Offers spring-like movement and bouncing attacks.

Fruits.name: T-Rex
Fruits.description: Transforms the user into a T-Rex, granting powerful close-range attacks.

Fruits.name: Tiger
Fruits.description: Allows the user to turn into a tiger, granting enhanced agility and powerful melee attacks.

Fruits.name: Venom
Fruits.description: Transforms the user into a venomous hydra, granting the user poison-based attacks that damage over time.

Fruits.name: Yeti
Fruits.description: Allows the user to turn into a hulking snow beast with cold attacks and ground-shaking strength.

Fruit Skins.name: Hellfire (Gas)
Fruit Skins.description: Allows the user to unleash hellish flames and transform into an infernal revenant wielding a blazing chainsaw.

Premium.name: Dark Blade
Premium.description: A mythical blade, forged from the darkest of metals and wielded by the strongest swordsman in the world.

Swords.name: Bisento
Swords.description: Radiates an aura of destruction. Interesting shape for a sword.

Swords.name: Buddy Sword
Swords.description: Created by a spirit infused into a blade, it carries elemental power.

Swords.name: Canvander
Swords.description: An elegant sword full of energy that scatters petals when used.

Swords.name: Cursed Dual Katana
Swords.description: Forged in the fires of both heaven and hell. Beware, for those who wield it risk being consumed by its curse.

Swords.name: Cutlass
Swords.description: A short, curved sword with a basic hilt, a sailor's weapon of choice.

Swords.name: Dark Blade
Swords.description: A mythical blade, forged from the darkest of metals and wielded by the strongest swordsman in the world.

Swords.name: Dark Dagger
Swords.description: Wielded by a proficient swordsman, it is small yet powerful.

Swords.name: Dog Blade
Swords.description: A peculiar weapon with a playful appearance and an explosive temper. Its tantrums are no joke.

Swords.name: Dragon Trident
Swords.description: Wielded by the keeper of tides, a spear that controls water with the power of a dragon.

Swords.name: Dragonheart
Swords.description: A spear that burns with eternal fury, rumored to carry the soul of a dragon's final roar.

Swords.name: Dual Katana
Swords.description: It's two katanas. Requires a bit more skill to not hit yourself.

Swords.name: Dual-Headed Blade
Swords.description: Be careful when swinging this. Hard to miss, though.

Swords.name: Flail
Swords.description: A smoke-infused flail that strikes with disorienting swings.

Swords.name: Fox Lamp
Swords.description: A mystical lamp with the essence of a clever fox. It illuminates the path with an otherworldly light.

Swords.name: Gravity Blade
Swords.description: Normally used as a walking aid, now used as a catalyst for gravity.

Swords.name: Hallow Scythe
Swords.description: A mythical scythe previously carried by the Soul Reaper. It has been hallowed for human use.

Swords.name: Iron Mace
Swords.description: Is guaranteed to knock your enemies away, although it weighs a lot.

Swords.name: Katana
Swords.description: A katana made out of regular steel, something a beginner samurai would pick.

Swords.name: Koko
Swords.description: A large katana with a hilt made of white fur, previously carried by a career surgeon.

Swords.name: Longsword
Swords.description: A straight double-edged sword with a cross-section shaped like a hexagon.

Swords.name: Midnight Blade
Swords.description: A double-edged sword with powers of the night and the ability to create portals.

Swords.name: Oroshi
Swords.description: One of the three Legendary Swords, infused with a soul.

Swords.name: Pipe
Swords.description: Seems to have been broken off some boat. Was it worth it?

Swords.name: Pole (1st Form)
Swords.description: Gives off a feint buzz of electricity. Very blunt.

Swords.name: Pole (2nd Form)
Swords.description: The second form of the Pole, capable of controlling lightning.

Swords.name: Rengoku
Swords.description: A katana made of fiery metals, forged by demons.

Swords.name: Saber
Swords.description: A sword that carries many burdens and lives, once used by an expert of its kind.

Swords.name: Saishi
Swords.description: One of the three Legendary Swords, infused with gold.

Swords.name: Shark Anchor
Swords.description: An anchor empowered by the spirit of a Terrorshark, capable of forcefully dragging foes into the depths.

Swords.name: Shark Saw
Swords.description: Rumored to be real shark teeth. Seems hard to swing.

Swords.name: Shizu
Swords.description: One of the three Legendary Swords, infused with a ghost.

Swords.name: Soul Cane
Swords.description: Seems to be able to conjure souls. Previously belonged to a king.

Swords.name: Spikey Trident
Swords.description: A legendary trident, forged for the prince of dough.

Swords.name: Trident
Swords.description: A spear with three prongs, with water-related powers left infused.

Swords.name: Triple Dark Blade
Swords.description: What happens when you triple the strongest sword in the game? This.

Swords.name: Triple Katana
Swords.description: Where would you fit a fourth one, anyway?

Swords.name: True Triple Katana
Swords.description: A mythical and more powerful variant of the Triple Katana, using the Legendary Swords.

Swords.name: Tushita
Swords.description: A legendary katana with the power of the skies and their stars.

Swords.name: Twin Hooks
Swords.description: Two identical hooks, made with the might of a beast. Use brutally.

Swords.name: Wardens Sword
Swords.description: Big sword, big range. The ring seems odd...

Swords.name: Yama
Swords.description: A legendary katana, said to be possessed by a demon.

Guns.name: Acidum Rifle
Guns.description: Acidum is Latin for acid. This rifle uses it as ammo, which does corrosive damage over time.

Guns.name: Bazooka
Guns.description: A rocket launcher with highly explosive power.

Guns.name: Bizarre Revolver
Guns.description: An eerie revolver that summons bullets from unknown dimensions. Who made this?

Guns.name: Cannon
Guns.description: Ahoy! How would your arm not break while holding this?

Guns.name: Dragonstorm
Guns.description: A minigun that channels a dragon’s essence, unleashing rounds that burst like fireworks.

Guns.name: Dual Flintlock
Guns.description: A pair of enhanced flintlock pistols, built with stronger wood and metal.

Guns.name: Flintlock
Guns.description: A firearm that uses a flint-striking ignition mechanism.

Guns.name: Kabucha
Guns.description: A tribal slingshot that channels spirits to unleash powerful attacks.

Guns.name: Magma Blaster
Guns.description: A fiery blaster that unleashes explosive magma blasts, incinerating targets instantly.

Guns.name: Musket
Guns.description: A muzzle-loaded firearm which specializes in heavy shots.

Guns.name: Refined Slingshot
Guns.description: A slingshot made with stronger wood and rubber bands.

Guns.name: Skull Guitar
Guns.description: A spooky guitar-like weapon, with the power to control the underworld.

Guns.name: Slingshot
Guns.description: A Y-shaped twig with two rubber bands attached to it. It doesn't get simpler.

Guns.name: Venom Bow
Guns.description: A bow with three hydra heads that spit venom, unleashing toxic streams.

Skills.name: Disguiser
Skills.description: Disguise yourself as nearby objects, players, or enemies.

Skills.name: Draconic Incandescence of the Vermillion Firmament
Skills.storageKey: Draconic Incandescence of the Vermillion Firmament
